metadata.article_title: No bar against permit holders to apply and hold licences under schemes.

article.title: No bar against permit holders to apply and hold licences under schemes.
article.content:
66BNo bar against permit holders to apply and hold licences under schemes.

Section 66B  ·  Chapter V  ·  page 48 of the Act
No person who holds the permit issued under this Act shall—
(a) be disqualified from applying for a licence under the scheme made under sub-section (3) of section 67 or sub-section (1) of section 88A by reason of holding such permit; and
(b) be required to get such permit cancelled on being issued a licence under any scheme made under this Act.]
